name: ambient-qa
description: internal QA of bise ambient.app (for ambient, ambient-pm, ambient-lead): launch the real app on a throwaway scripted hub (or the real workspace, read-only), drive it without the user's hands (any core or app event, fn, fn + key, a fake voice that reaches the fake main), read its model and events, and take PNGs of the capsule and of the screen composite; scenes() plays every SPEC §2 state and returns a contact sheet. Never the mic, the speaker, the user's screen or the real main.
